ui.mobile_layout.description.zh-CN: 调整移动、瞄准射击和街机按钮的位置。摇杆支持大小与透明度；布局保存在当前设备。
ui.mobile_layout.description.en-US: Move and aim/fire with two sticks. Drag arcade buttons to reposition them and adjust stick size and opacity. Saved on this device.

ui.mobile_layout.edit_hint.zh-CN: 拖动摇杆或街机按钮调整位置；大小和透明度仅应用于摇杆。
ui.mobile_layout.edit_hint.en-US: Drag sticks or arcade buttons. Size and opacity apply to sticks.

ui.settings.visual.controls_subtitle.en-US: Select a key to change its binding

ui.settings.network.game_hint.zh-CN: 下次联机时使用此地址。
ui.settings.network.game_hint.en-US: Used the next time you connect.

ui.settings.network.game_load_failed.zh-CN: 读取联机服务器地址失败。
ui.settings.network.game_load_failed.en-US: Could not load the game server address.

ui.settings.network.resource_hint.zh-CN: 应用后，检查更新立即使用此地址。
ui.settings.network.resource_hint.en-US: Update checks use this address as soon as you apply it.

ui.settings.network.resource_load_failed.zh-CN: 读取资源服务器地址失败。
ui.settings.network.resource_load_failed.en-US: Could not load the resource server address.

ui.settings.network.game_saved.en-US: Saved. Applies the next time you connect.

ui.settings.network.resource_saved.zh-CN: 已应用，可立即检查更新。
ui.settings.network.resource_saved.en-US: Applied. You can check for updates now.

ui.settings.network.game_invalid.en-US: Enter an IP address or hostname with a port.

ui.settings.network.resource_invalid.en-US: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS address.
